items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Where are you living now, Singh?

ctx.x: No, no. Nobody hires you at this age steady.
But I mean, do you get a fair amount of work, enough to live on? Enough to live on, yeah. Keep you in beer and stuff. Yeah. Where are you living now, Singh?
